question: An angle greater than 180 degrees is referred to as ________________.
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

A reflex angle is an angle that measures greater than 180 degrees but less than 360 degrees. It is larger than a straight angle (180 degrees) and smaller than a complete angle (360 degrees). Reflex angles are often encountered in geometric problems, especially when dealing with the exterior angles of polygons or rotational measures.

**Properties of Reflex Angles:**

 
• A reflex angle is always more than 180° but less than 360°.
 
• It is the larger angle formed on the exterior side when two lines intersect or when an angle is extended beyond a straight angle.
 
• Reflex angles are supplementary to acute, obtuse, or right angles when measured on the exterior side of the vertex.
